facts.fact: Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office, led by Director Baker Birikujja, is acting as the regulator and presented audit findings on 15 government bodies.

The Personal Data Protection Office audited 15 ministries, departments and agencies between November 2025 and April 2026, rating two compliant, five partially compliant and eight non-compliant, with no decision against a named body.
Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office, led by Director Baker Birikujja, is operating and presented audit findings on 15 government bodies.
The Personal Data Protection Office audited 15 government bodies between November 2025 and April 2026 and launched an audit and inspection manual.
